name: 115.简

basedOn.note: Test19 is the latest explicitly device-validated recovery baseline. Test21 deterministically rebuilds File Management from the immutable Test17 V9 source, carries the small Test20 recent-play hook, and adds current-folder search as a separate bounded module. Test20 itself has not yet been separately device-validated.

features: add a compact 搜索 entry to File Management for searching only the current folder level
use the already working getFiles directory-list contract instead of touching the fragile global 115Search request chain
scan at most 5 pages x 100 items per explicit search action; offer 继续扫描 for the next bounded chunk when needed
search results can open folders, play videos, and open File Information without background polling or concurrency
keep the Test20 recent-play/store modules installed so recent playback data and the ▶ 最近 entry remain available
rebuild File Management from the immutable device-validated Test17 V9 source before adding only simple toolbar/playback hooks

safety.folderSearchRequestBound: maximum 5 sequential getFiles calls per explicit scan action
safety.syntaxGuard: folder_search_v1.js and installer.js passed node --check before publication; installer runs new Function() on final File Management/store/history/folder-search sources before saving

limitations: Current-folder search is intentionally non-recursive and does not enter child folders.
Very large folders are scanned in bounded 500-item chunks; the user explicitly taps 继续扫描 to inspect the next chunk.
Test20 recent-play behavior is carried forward but still needs device validation together with this Test21 build.
validationTarget: File Management opens normally with no JavaScript compile error
the new 搜索 entry opens a short clean input without verbose helper text
searching a known filename in the current folder returns matching files/folders
folder results open the correct directory and video results play normally
继续扫描 appears only when the current 500-item scan chunk is full and more items may remain
existing global 115 search, file operations, account center, offline center, recycle bin and external magnet flow do not regress
▶ 最近 and recent-play recording remain functional if the user tests that path
